subject: literacy
concept: Identifying an author's purpose and intended audience for a given text
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts text excerpt cards by likely intended audience (children, experts, general public)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a text's tone and vocabulary level to its most likely intended audience
exercise.abstract: Student identifies a text's purpose and audience and explains the textual clues that reveal them

misconception_flags: identifies the topic rather than the author's actual purpose (to persuade, inform, entertain)

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
